form: A small glade in a thick English broadleaf wood seen from a tiny Alice's height: towering grass and a great spear thistle at the centre, oak and hazel trunks rising into a closed canopy; no built structure

grows_from.waking_detail: a thistle patch among the trees of a hedgerow copse near home

mucha_design_language.item: Mucha / Art Nouveau carried by the living wood at x9: the spear thistle's leaves and stems rise in flowing whiplash curves with its purple heads as stylised rosettes; bracken fronds unfurl in spiral croziers; honeysuckle and bindweed trail in garland loops between grass blades; a round gap in the canopy above the thistle throws a halo of light; pastel-and-gold palette of lilac thistle, sage and dappled gold; no built ornament
mucha_design_language.why: Same flora-borne language as SCN-caterpillar-clearing so the two x9 wood scenes cut together

structure.item: glade about 12 m across (true units) ringed by oak, ash and hazel coppice stools
structure.note: 'a thick wood'; species and size inferred from Thames-valley copse (geography.json LOC-riverside-region flora)

structure.item: a great spear thistle about 1.2 m tall (true units) with spiny leaves and purple flower heads at the centre of the glade
a raised bank of roots on one side where the puppy looks down 'just over her head'
structure.note: raised bank inferred to stage the puppy above Alice

materials.item: long woodland grass, bracken, bramble and dead-leaf litter underfoot
loose broken sticks on the ground
mossy oak bark and grey hazel stems

details.item: dappled canopy light through oak leaves (fixture note only; values belong to lighting)
details.note: geography.json LOC-thick-wood sky 'dappled through the tree canopy'

details.item: a few hawthorn sprays at the glade edge

scale_notes.anchor: Alice's effective height here about 15 cm, the same as in SCN-caterpillar-clearing, where the mushroom is 'about the same height as herself' (ch004-p41). Scale factor x9.

builds.beat: Alice wanders, the puppy looks down at her, she dodges round the thistle teasing it with a stick
builds.build: oversized x9 ground build: grass blades 2.7 m, thistle lower stems and spiny leaf rosette to 4 m with separate x9 flower-head inserts, sticks 1 to 2 m long and as thick as Alice's arm, leaf litter at x9; tree trunks at the glade edge as painted and built backings

builds.beat: the enormous puppy (CRE-002, non-speaking dream animal)
builds.build: proposal: a photoreal CGI puppy (per BIB-0027's extension of the photoreal-animal register to non-speaking dream animals, cultivation.json#SUP-002) composited on the raised root bank of the x9 set at giant apparent scale, with physical interaction effects (bent grass, thrown sticks, dust) built practically; fallback if H2 rejects CGI: real puppy on a raised 1:1 bank in forced perspective as before

negative: no buildings, paths, fences or signposts
no fairy-tale glowing flowers or giant fantasy fungi
no cartoon puppy (CGI puppy is photoreal; treatment pending_H2)
no autumn colours; full midsummer green
no flat poster illustration, outline graphics or matte-painting finish
prompt_ready_en: a small glade in a thick English oak and hazel wood seen from ground level at tiny scale, towering blades of grass and bracken fronds unfurling in spirals, a huge spear thistle with spiny leaves rising in flowing whiplash curves and purple flower heads in the centre under a round halo of light from a gap in the canopy, honeysuckle trailing in garland loops, fallen sticks as big as logs, leaf litter, mossy oak trunks rising into a green midsummer canopy, Art Nouveau lines after Mucha, soft pastel-and-gold light, photographed live-action set
